bundle.shortDescription: Offline LAN chat, calls, files and games
bundle.longDescription: LANTern is a fully offline communication suite for devices on the same local network. Chat, voice and video calls, file transfer, folder hosting and games — with no accounts, no cloud and no outbound internet connections.
